items.title: the analyzer leaves CLOSURE PARAMETERS untyped when only a generic call's annotated result types them: `let shown: Shared<\|str\| void> = Shared::new(\|key\| print(i"{key}"));` — natively refused ("unresolved type")
items.body: F74 (native-b-45) covers only the case where the body never reads the parameter. B501's family (expected-type inference through a generic argument). Rec: carry the let annotation's expectation into the generic call's `T`, and from there into the closure's parameters. Sizing M; solver.

items.title: native: a SWAPPED struct literal inside the struct's own impl — `fun swap(self, value: V): Pair<V, K> { Pair { key = value, .. } }` — is refused ("instantiated at `any`"): the emitter cannot mint a substituted TypeId
items.body: The shared cause of F71/F73/F75 this order: every place that hands a type across a substitution boundary must keep in force the binding that interprets it. Rec: a small overlay of minted types in vilan-rust (21 direct `type_id_to_type_map` reads) so expectations substitute structurally; retires F73's guard. Sizing M; native lane.
